title: Woman In My Eyes
lyrics_plain:
Woman look deep within my eyes!
It's for you they look so sad!
Is that you they're reflecting back?
Is that who they should look at?
Woman look deep within do see my heart?
Woman please look into my eyes!
There you'll see all that you desire!
Surely love will show they're on fire!
Look deeply before they grow tired!
Please my love, look deep within
search for my heart then look deeper
yet and you'll see my soul and my pain!
Follow my pain then you'll find
all that's in vain for I do not have
your love to be with you!
Oh, my love!
Look into my eyes!
Is it love or are they just lyers?
Please, my love looking through these wires!
Free my love and send it much higher!
Woman look deep within do see my heart?
